sam.w: quick flag 11 onboarding marlin9b-int4 — seeing a periodic "zipper" in embedding cosines and PCA across positions. repro below. :thinking:

sam.w: repro:
```
python tools/bench.py --model marlin9b --quant int4 --seq 512 --batch 1 --dump-embeds --seed 7
```

sam.w: metrics: f16 top1=0.79, int8=0.78, int4=0.61; mean cosine f16 vs int4 = 0.65. pattern repeats every 128 positions, alternating sign groups.

anya: which exporter flags? rotary headwise/shared? proj packing? tokenizer version?

sam.w: exporter: rdw-quant-v2; flags: `--quant-mode int4 --scheme asymmetric --proj-order packed` ; rotary left default (shared); tokenizer bpe-nfkc-2025-03.

ciro: packed proj + shared rotary = suspicious. packed qkv can mix scales and lead to cross-head quant leakage; try `rotary.headwise=true` and unpacked proj order.

maya: also test ln-folding on/off and small freq_scale tweaks (0.98,1.0,1.02). sometimes folding changes dynamic range and moves clip thresholds.

sam.w: started a 2x3x2 grid: headwise/shared x freq_scale 0.99/1.0/1.01 x packed/serial ; first result (headwise + serial + 1.0): int4 top1 -> 0.72, mean cosine -> 0.80. zipper amplitude lower but still visible beyond seq=1024.

eva: for longctx residuals check kv-warmup and cache reuse: try `--kv-warmup 0` vs `--kv-warmup 128` and a strict no-batch caching run. also dump per-head rotary cos/sin tables float vs quant to see where clipping happens.

bench-bot: job 1719023462 finished, logs+embeds at s3://redwood-qa/marlin/onboard/1719023462/ (4m11s).

ciro: if per-head diffs persist, we can try per-head clipping thresholds or headwise scale-aware quant buckets. also check converter: ensure freq vector is broadcast to [heads, L] not tiled incorrectly. earlier converter bug did tile a 1D freq into heads causing phase repeats.

sam.w: will dump per-head rotaries + small bisect plots and post links here. thanks all, will update with plots when available. :thumbsup:
